description.en: Use for "how does X work", code walkthroughs before changing something, and placement / ownership / layering questions ("where should this live", "which package owns this", "is this the right layer"). Explains subsystem architecture, runtime flow, onboarding mental models. Use why for motivation.
description.zh: 用于「X 是怎么运作的」、改动之前的代码讲解，以及放在哪、归谁管、分在哪一层的问题（「这个该放在哪」「哪个包负责这个」「这是不是对的那一层」）。讲解子系统的架构、运行时的流程，以及帮新人上手时要搭起的整体理解。问动机用 why。

blocks.en: Explore the codebase to answer "how does X work?" questions.
blocks.zh: 探索代码库，回答「X 是怎么运作的？」这类问题。

blocks.en: If the scope is ambiguous, state your interpretation and explore. The user can redirect.
blocks.zh: 如果范围不明确，说出你的理解，然后开始探索。用户可以纠正方向。

blocks.en: Spawn one read-only general-purpose subagent that explores and explains in one pass: `Task` with `subagent_type: generalPurpose` and `readonly: true` in Cursor, `Agent` in Claude Code (`subagent_type: general-purpose`), `task` in OpenCode (`subagent_type: general`), `spawn_agent` in Codex. If your harness has no subagent tool, as in Pi without an extension, do the exploring and writing yourself. Give it the user's question and this brief:
blocks.zh: 派一个只看不改的通用帮手 AI，一次完成探索和讲解：Cursor 里是 `Task`，设 `subagent_type: generalPurpose` 和 `readonly: true`；Claude Code 里是 `Agent`（`subagent_type: general-purpose`）；OpenCode 里是 `task`（`subagent_type: general`）；Codex 里是 `spawn_agent`。如果你所用的工具没有帮手 AI 工具，比如没装扩展的 Pi，就自己来探索和写。把用户的问题和下面这份说明交给它：

blocks.en: > You are writing an architectural explanation for a senior engineer. Explore the codebase and write an explanation that a senior engineer unfamiliar with this area could read and walk away with a solid mental model. They should understand the architecture well enough to start working in it confidently. You have read-only access to the codebase.
blocks.zh: > 你在为一位资深工程师写一份架构讲解。探索代码库，写出一份讲解，让一位不熟悉这块的资深工程师读完，能在脑子里搭起一个扎实的模型。对方应该把这套架构理解到足以放心地开始在里面干活。你对代码库只有只读权限。

blocks.en: Present the subagent's output. Light edits for clarity or context from the conversation are fine. Do not substantially rewrite it.
blocks.zh: 把帮手 AI 的输出呈现出来。为了更清楚，或者补上对话里的背景，做些小改动没问题。不要大幅重写。

lessons.quote: They should understand the architecture well enough to start working in it confidently.
lessons.quoteZh: 对方应该把这套架构理解到足以放心地开始在里面干活。

zh.title: 用读完能做什么来定深度
zh.does: 讲解讲到你能放心动手改这块代码为止，不会停在泛泛的概述，也不会变成逐行念代码。
zh.why: 「讲细一点」没有标准；说出读者读完要能做成什么，AI 就有了一把尺子，知道讲到哪算够。
zh.try: 让 AI 讲解时说清读完要能做什么：「讲到我能自己改这份配置就行。」

en.title: Set depth by what the reader can do
en.does: It explains until you could start changing this code with confidence, no shallower and no line-by-line tour.
en.why: "More detail" has no measure; naming what the reader should be able to do gives the AI a ruler for enough.
en.try: Say what you need to do afterward: "Explain enough that I can change this config myself."

zh.title: 转交时划好能改多少
zh.does: 帮手写好的讲解，主对话基本原样交给你，只为讲清楚做些小改动。
zh.why: 先说「小改动可以」，再说「不要大幅重写」，AI 就不会把一份好讲解重新压成自己的摘要，丢掉细节。
zh.try: 让 AI 整理别人写的东西时说：「只改错字和断句，可以补一句背景，不要重写。」

en.title: Say how much a handoff may change
en.does: The main chat passes the helper's explanation to you nearly as written, with light edits for clarity.
en.why: Allowing light edits and ruling out a rewrite stops the AI from squeezing a good explanation into its own lossy summary.
en.try: When the AI tidies someone else's text: "Fix typos and breaks, add a line of context if needed, but don't rewrite it."

lessons.quote: If the scope is ambiguous, state your interpretation and explore.
lessons.quoteZh: 如果范围不明确，说出你的理解，然后开始探索。

zh.title: 先说理解再动手
zh.does: 问题含糊时，它先说出自己怎么理解，然后直接去查，你随时可以纠正。
zh.why: 让 AI 把理解说出来再继续，既不卡住等你，又让你看得见它有没有理解偏。
zh.try: 加一句：「我说得不清楚的地方，先写一句你的理解，然后接着做，不用等我回复。」

en.title: State your reading, then start
en.does: When the question is vague, it says how it reads it and gets going; you can redirect any time.
en.why: Saying its reading out loud means it doesn't stall waiting for you, and you can see if it misread.
en.try: Add: "Where I'm unclear, write one line on how you read it, then keep going without waiting for me."

compare.without: 罗列文件和函数，读完还是不知道整体怎么搭
compare.with: 写一份架构讲解，让不熟这块的资深工程师读完能放心上手

compare.without: 一边查一边顺手改了代码
compare.with: 派出去的那个帮手 AI 只看不改

compare.without: 问题说不清时自己闷头猜一个
compare.with: 先写出自己怎么理解，接着去查，你随时可以改方向

zh.intro: 它回答「X 是怎么运作的」这类问题。范围不明确时，先说出自己的理解再去查，你随时可以改方向。
sections: 派一个只看不改的帮手 AI，一次查完并写讲解，目标是不熟这块的资深工程师读完就能上手。
把帮手写的讲解交给你，只为讲清楚做些小改动，不大幅重写。

compare.without: Lists files and functions without showing how the whole fits together.
compare.with: Writes an architectural explanation a senior engineer new to the area could start working from.

compare.without: Edits code while it looks around.
compare.with: Sends one read-only helper, so your code stays untouched.

compare.without: Silently guesses what an unclear question means.
compare.with: States its reading of the question, then explores. You can redirect anytime.

en.intro: It answers "how does X work" questions. If the scope is unclear, it states its reading and explores, and you can redirect.
sections: Sends one read-only helper that explores and writes the explanation in one pass, aimed at a senior engineer new to the area.
Hands you the helper's text with only light edits for clarity, never a rewrite.
